descriptionBlocks.text: Bonus for 1/2/3 Heroes:
Family effect: status effect on special.

1: Deals 480% damage to all enemies.

The caster regenerates 780 HP over 6 turns.
2: Deals 485% damage to all enemies.

Alters the power of all Ice shields on the board. When an attacking Hero casts the special, the shields become enhanced with 52% attack. When a defending Hero casts the special, the shields become weakened with -25.4% attack.

The caster regenerates 1140 HP over 6 turns.
5: Deals 500% damage to all enemies.

Alters the power of all Ice shields on the board. When an attacking Hero casts the special, the shields become enhanced with 58% attack. When a defending Hero casts the special, the shields become weakened with 48.4% attack.
The caster regenerates 1260 HP over 6 turns.
6: Deals 505% damage to all enemies.

Alters the power of all Ice shields on the board. When an attacking Hero casts the special, the shields become enhanced with 60% attack. When a defending Hero casts the special, the shields become weakened with 73% attack.
The caster regenerates 1380 HP over 6 turns.
7: Deals 510% damage to all enemies.

Alters the power of all Ice shields on the board. When an attacking Hero casts the special, the shields become enhanced with 62% attack. When a defending Hero casts the special, the shields become weakened with 97.6% attack.
The caster regenerates 1500 HP over 6 turns.
8: Deals 515% damage to all enemies.

Alters the power of all Ice shields on the board. When an attacking Hero casts the special, the shields become enhanced with 64% attack. When a defending Hero casts the special, the shields become weakened with 122.2% attack.
The caster regenerates 1620 HP over 6 turns.

effects.text:
At the start of the battle summons 1/2 Sly Fox Minions for self, with 2% health and 100% attack inherited from the hero.
[*]Sly Fox Minion has 80% chance to dodge incoming attacks. 
[*]When Sly Fox Minion dodges, it steals latest dispellable buff from the attacker and gives it to its owner.

descriptionBlocks.text: Fox heroes summon a Sly Fox Minion for themselves at the start of the battle.

Sly Fox Minion has 80% chance to dodge incoming attacks.
When Sly Fox Minion dodges, it steals latest dispellable buff from the attacker and gives it to its owner.

passives.description:
The Construct Core of this character is a Minion Core.

The Minion Core activates each time this character's Special Skill is cast:

[*] With a fully charged Minion Core, summons a Killer Bot Minion with 5% HP and 11% attack inherited from the caster on all allies.
[*] The HP and attack inherited from the caster are scaled by the amount of charge in the Core. All charge is exhausted when the Core is activated.
[*]The Killer Bot Minion recovers 7% health for its owner at the end of each turn.
[*]Wither: Each hit from a Killer Bot Minion gives its target -4 attack.

passives.title: Minion Core
passives.description:
The Construct Core of this character is a Minion Core.

The Minion Core activates each time this character's Special Skill is cast:

[*] With a fully charged Minion Core, summons a Killer Bot Minion with 5% HP and 11% attack inherited from the caster on all allies.
[*] The HP and attack inherited from the caster are scaled by the amount of charge in the Core. All charge is exhausted when the Core is activated.
[*]The Killer Bot Minion recovers 7% health for its owner at the end of each turn.
[*]Wither: Each hit from a Killer Bot Minion gives its target -4 attack.

passives.title: Minion Core
passives.description:
The Construct Core of this character is a Minion Core.

The Minion Core activates each time this character's Special Skill is cast:

[*] With a fully charged Minion Core, summons a Killer Bot Minion with 5% HP and 11% attack inherited from the caster on all allies.
[*] The HP and attack inherited from the caster are scaled by the amount of charge in the Core. All charge is exhausted when the Core is activated.
[*]The Killer Bot Minion recovers 7% health for its owner at the end of each turn.
[*]Wither: Each hit from a Killer Bot Minion gives its target -4 attack.

passives.title: Minion Core
passives.description:
The Construct Core of this character is a Minion Core.

The Minion Core activates each time this character's Special Skill is cast:

[*] With a fully charged Minion Core, summons a Killer Bot Minion with 5% HP and 11% attack inherited from the caster on all allies.
[*] The HP and attack inherited from the caster are scaled by the amount of charge in the Core. All charge is exhausted when the Core is activated.
[*]The Killer Bot Minion recovers 7% health for its owner at the end of each turn.
[*]Wither: Each hit from a Killer Bot Minion gives its target -4 attack.

passives.description:
This character gets more powerful the fewer allies there are on the battlefield.

Bonus for 5/4/3/2/1 remaining allies:
[*]50%/40%/30%/20%/0% attack.
[*]50%/40%/30%/20%/0% defense.

descriptionBlocks.text: This character gets more powerful the fewer allies there are on the battlefield.

effects.text:
Bounty activates if the enemy receives 2500/2250/2000 cumulative damage.
[*] Bounty deals 1200 damage to the enemy when activated.

When defending Heroes cast their Special Skills, they will prioritize enemies with a Bounty.
[*] Each enemy can only have one Bounty. If they would receive a new one, the damage on activation is increased by 300 instead.
[*] Bounty will be removed when it activates or once its duration ends.
